title: pvExtractSelectioninternal
body:
## pvExtractSelectioninternal

Internal ParaView variant of Extract Selection (vtkPVExtractSelection) with three output ports: 0 the extracted dataset, 1 a selection of the extracted point/cell indices, and 2 the input selection passed through; select a port with {"node": id, "port": n}. ParaView documents it as internal and recommends Extract Selection; use pvExtractSelection unless you need the index selection on port 1.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Unlike pvExtractSelection it has no PreserveTopology option and accepts no table input.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractSelectioninternal`. Identity: `filters/PVExtractSelection`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input from which the selection is extracted. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `Selection` | Required data input for the native Selection port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input that provides the selection object. Accepted data: selections (vtkSelection). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkSelection"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `HyperTreeGridToUnstructuredGrid` | Output an unstructured grid instead of a hyper tree grid for input hyper tree grids. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvExtractSelectioninternal",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input",
    "Selection": "UPSTREAM_Selection"
  }
}
```
